research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Talyn Air is researching a vehicle, system, and method for vertical take off and landing that uses a carrier vehicle with fuselages, wings, and attach units to support a separate cruise vehicle. The disclosed VTOL configuration focuses on coordinated operation of the carrier and cruise vehicles to enable efficient vertical launch and transition to forward flight. Overall, Talyn Air is developing multi vehicle VTOL architectures and integrated VTOL flight methods.

overview_description.description:
Talyn Air is an electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft system.

It separates and recombines in the air and allows each vehicle to operate at peak efficiency without wasting energy.

Jamie Gull and Evan Mucasey established it in Los Angeles, California.
